elements.requirement: If an individual is, or apart from section 1K would be, chargeable to capital gains tax for a tax year on chargeable gains, the annual exempt amount for that year must be deducted from those gains, but no further than is necessary to eliminate them.
elements.quote: the annual exempt amount for the year is to be deducted from those gains (but no further than necessary to eliminate them)

elements.requirement: The annual exempt amount for a tax year is £3,000.
elements.quote: The annual exempt amount for a tax year is £3,000.

elements.requirement: The deduction of the annual exempt amount must be made after the deduction of allowable losses accruing in the tax year.
elements.quote: is made after the deduction of allowable losses accruing in the tax year

elements.requirement: The deduction of the annual exempt amount must be made before the deduction of allowable losses accruing in a previous tax year or, if section 62 applies, in a subsequent tax year.
elements.quote: is made before the deduction of allowable losses accruing in a previous tax year or, if section 62 applies, in a subsequent tax year

elements.requirement: A person chargeable to capital gains tax may deduct the annual exempt amount from gains in whatever way is most beneficial to them, regardless of the tax rate that would otherwise have applied to those gains.
elements.quote: The annual exempt amount may be deducted from gains in whatever way is most beneficial to a person chargeable to capital gains tax (irrespective of the rate of tax at which the gains would otherwise have been charged)

elements.requirement: An individual is not entitled to an annual exempt amount for a tax year if the individual makes a foreign gain claim, a foreign income claim, or a foreign employment election for that tax year.
elements.quote: An individual is not entitled to an annual exempt amount for a tax year if (b) the individual makes a foreign gain claim, a foreign income claim or a foreign employment election for that tax year.

elements.requirement: For the tax year in which an individual dies and for the next two tax years, section 1K applies to the deceased individual's personal representatives as if references to the individual were to those personal representatives.
elements.quote: For the tax year in which an individual dies and for the next two tax years, this section applies to the individual's personal representatives as if references to the individual were to those personal representatives.

elements.requirement: Section 1K applies in relation to trustees in accordance with the provision made by Schedule 1C.
elements.quote: This section applies in relation to trustees in accordance with the provision made by Schedule 1C.
